failure_pattern: Moderate-liquidity ETF rotation setups are skipped, concentrating exposure in the most liquid names and reducing diversification benefit.
hypothesis: Tightening liquidity thresholds intelligently can improve ETF rotation coverage without degrading execution quality.
iteration_guidance: Use relative liquidity vs sector median instead of absolute threshold.
Maintain strict rejection for names below sector 25th percentile.
Preserve defensive-rotation priority during elevated dispersion.
